appliedUpdates.description: No updates needed — existing validation surface documentation was accurate and complete for the helium milestone

VAL-HELIUM-001.summary: Helium keychain entry name verified. Primary entry 'Helium Safe Storage'/'Helium' follows Chromium convention. Fallback 'Helium Storage Key'/'Helium' preserved for resilience. Extensive code comments document research rationale.

VAL-HELIUM-002.summary: 2 keychain entries confirmed: primary 'Helium Safe Storage'/'Helium' and fallback 'Helium Storage Key'/'Helium'. Test: 'Helium keychain entries: has fallback entry for resilience' passes.

VAL-HELIUM-003.summary: getBrowser('helium') returns all correct properties: id='helium', displayName='Helium', cookieBackend='chromium', keychainEntries.length>=2, linuxPath, winPath. Test passes.

VAL-HELIUM-004.summary: browserUserDataDir('helium') resolves to ~/Library/Application Support/net.imput.helium on macOS. Test passes.

VAL-HELIUM-005.summary: Helium has linuxPath='.config/helium' and winPath='AppData/Local/Helium/User Data'. Both are non-empty strings. Test passes.

VAL-HELIUM-006.summary: loadChromeSessionConfig({ browserId: 'helium' }) resolves correctly via CLI flag and FT_BROWSER env var. Both paths tested and pass.

VAL-HELIUM-007.summary: Mocked keychain lookup resolves to Helium-specific entries. Cookie DB path resolves to Helium user data directory. Tests pass.

VAL-HELIUM-008.summary: Error messages use browser.displayName='Helium' producing actionable Helium-specific errors. loadChromeSessionConfig error template references browser.displayName.

VAL-HELIUM-009.summary: 'ft sync --browser helium' is recognized by CLI, helium appears in browser IDs list. No 'unknown browser' or config resolution errors. Only expected 'Couldn't connect to browser session' error (Helium not running).
